shell.tagline: Reward-based crowdfunding. Creators publish campaigns, backers pledge, and nobody is charged unless a campaign reaches its goal by its deadline.

pledges.label: Pledges
pledges.summary: What you have backed, and what you can still change.

saved.label: Saved projects

pledges.metaDescription: Every campaign you have backed, and what you chose.
pledges.title: Your pledges
pledges.intro: Every campaign you have backed. Nothing has been charged yet — a pledge is collected when its campaign closes successfully, and you can change or withdraw one until then.

saved.metaDescription: The campaigns you saved to come back to.
saved.title: Saved projects
saved.intro: Campaigns you saved to come back to. Saving is private — a creator is not told.

following.metaDescription: The creators whose launches you are told about.
following.title: Following
following.intro: Creators you follow. Each one sends you a message when they launch something new.

surveys.metaDescription: What creators still need from you before they can ship your rewards.
surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.intro: After a campaign funds, its creator asks what they need in order to send your reward — a size, a colour, an edition. You can change an answer while the survey is open.

deliveries.metaDescription: Where each of your rewards is, and where it is going.
deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.intro: One row per reward you are owed. A creator records the carrier and the tracking number as they pack, so a row with nothing under it has not been sent yet.

inbox.metaDescription: Everything IdeaNest has told you, newest first.
inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.intro: Everything the platform has told you, newest first. Opening one marks it read. <settings>Change what you are sent</settings>.

language.title: Language
language.intro: Choose the language IdeaNest writes to you in.
language.fieldHint: Applies to your account pages straight away. The public site is still in English while the rest of the translation is written.
language.failed: That language could not be saved. Try again.
language.currencyNote: Every campaign on IdeaNest is funded in manat today, so there is nothing here to choose between. A display currency arrives with the second one.

profile.metaDescription: Your name, biography, picture, website, location and links, as everybody else sees them.
profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: What strangers see when they open your profile or a campaign you created. To hide the page altogether, go to <privacy>privacy</privacy>.

notifications.metaDescription: Choose what IdeaNest tells you, and how it reaches you.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose what you are told and how it reaches you. As it happens sends each one on its own; daily digest collects them into one message a day, where the channel supports it. In app is what fills your notifications. Changes save as you make them.

sessions.metaDescription: Review the devices signed in to your IdeaNest account and sign out of any of them.
sessions.title: Devices
sessions.intro: Every device currently signed in to your account. If you do not recognise one, sign it out — it stops being able to refresh within fifteen minutes.

email.metaDescription: Move your IdeaNest account to a different email address.
email.title: Email address
email.intro: The address you sign in with, and where everything IdeaNest sends you goes. To change your password instead, go to <password>password</password>.

password.metaDescription: Change the password on your IdeaNest account.
password.title: Password
password.intro: Changing it needs the one you have now. If you do not have it — or you have only ever signed in with Google or Apple — <reset>reset it by email</reset> instead.

security.metaDescription: Add a code from your phone to your IdeaNest sign-in.
security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.intro: A code from your phone, on top of your password. §4.1 requires it before a payout, so a creator will meet it sooner or later. To see which browsers are signed in, go to <devices>devices</devices>.

privacy.metaDescription: Choose who can see your profile, download a copy of your IdeaNest data, or close your account.
privacy.title: Privacy, data and closure
privacy.intro: Who can see you, everything IdeaNest holds about you, and what happens to it if you leave.

hero.title: Fund what does not exist yet
hero.standfirst: Creators publish a campaign with a goal and a deadline. Backers pledge. Nobody is charged unless the goal is reached in time — and if it is not, nothing is collected at all.

closing.heading: Ending soon
closing.standfirst: Campaigns whose deadline is closest. All-or-nothing means these are the ones a pledge still changes.

launched.heading: Recently launched
launched.standfirst: The newest campaigns to open for pledges.

categories.heading: Browse by category
categories.standfirst: Fifteen categories, each with its own page — and each of those with its subcategories.

empty.heading: No campaigns to show right now
empty.body: Nothing is open for pledges at this moment. The feed carries everything on the platform, including campaigns that have already closed.

discover.metaDescription: Browse and filter every campaign on IdeaNest.

categories.metaDescription: Every category and subcategory on IdeaNest, each with its own page of campaigns.
categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Every category on the platform, and the subcategories inside them. Each has a page of its own.

collections.metaDescription: Staff selections, themed collections, and open calls on IdeaNest — each with its own page of campaigns.

search.title: Search
search.prompt: Type what you are looking for — a campaign, a category, a maker. Or <feed>browse the whole feed</feed> and narrow it with filters.
search.count: {count, plural, =0 {No campaigns matched} one {# campaign} other {# campaigns}}
search.countMore: {count, plural, =0 {No campaigns matched} one {# campaign, with more in the feed} other {# campaigns, with more in the feed}}
search.emptyBody: Check the spelling, or try a shorter word. The feed can be narrowed by category, status and amount instead of by phrase.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.intro: Pick a reward, or choose to pledge without one — both are pledges.
checkout.expired: A reservation lasts five minutes and this one has ended, so the stock has gone back to the campaign. Nothing was confirmed and no card was involved.

reward.hint: One reward per pledge. Add-ons come next.
reward.noneHint: Back the campaign because you want it to exist. You choose the amount, and you get no reward in return.
reward.chooseOne: Choose one of the options above

addons.heading: Add-ons
addons.intro: Extras you can add to any reward, or to a pledge without one.

destination.label: Where should this go?
destination.hint: Delivery is charged per destination, and the creator sets the rate.

contribution.hint: Every amount goes to the campaign.

summary.label: Pledge summary
summary.empty: Choose a reward, or choose to pledge without one, and the total appears here.
summary.pending: The total appears once the choices above are complete.

payment.heading: Payment
payment.body: This campaign records your pledge without taking a payment method. Card details are not collected anywhere on this page, and nothing you confirm here charges you.
payment.later: Money is only ever collected if the campaign reaches its goal, and you will be told before that happens.

anonymous.label: Pledge anonymously
anonymous.hint: Your name is kept off this campaign

checkout.reserved: Your reward is reserved for five minutes. Review your pledge and confirm it.

review.heading: What you are backing
review.notCharged: Confirming records your pledge. It does not charge you.

done.heading: The campaign has your pledge and your reward is yours if it reaches its goal.
done.keepReference: Keep the reference above if you need to write to the campaign about this pledge.
done.released: Your card was checked and released, not charged.
done.noMethod: No payment method was collected, and nothing is taken unless the campaign reaches its goal by its deadline.
done.methodKept: The payment method you gave is kept for later, and nothing is taken unless the campaign reaches its goal by its deadline.
done.expired: Your reward is no longer held

errors.amountMissing: Enter how much you would like to give.
errors.amountPrecision: An amount can have at most two decimal places.
errors.amountTooLarge: That is more than this platform can take in one pledge.
errors.amountTooSmall: A pledge has to be more than nothing.
errors.destinationMissing: Something in this pledge is posted, so the campaign needs to know where to send it.
errors.totalTooSmall: A pledge has to come to more than nothing.
errors.amountMissingMinimum: Enter how much you would like to give — at least {minimum}.
errors.amountComma: Use a full stop for the decimal point: 45.50, not 45,50.
errors.amountNotANumber: Amounts are digits and at most one full stop, like 45.00.
errors.belowRewardPrice: This reward costs {price}. Give that or more, or choose a cheaper reward.
errors.destinationUnpriced: The creator has not set a delivery cost to this destination for {lines}. Choose somewhere else, or take that out of your pledge.

campaign.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Last day} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
campaign.backers: {count, plural, =0 {No backers} one {# backer} other {# backers}}

trust.heading: How funding works here
trust.body: The platform connects creators with backers. Rewards are not guaranteed, but creators must keep backers informed. You are only charged if the project reaches its goal by the deadline.

outcome.notFunded: This campaign did not reach its goal
outcome.reached: It reached its goal before the deadline.
outcome.notReached: It did not reach its goal before the deadline.
outcome.settling: The figures above are what the campaign raised at its deadline. Every confirmed pledge is collected after it closes, so the amount shown elsewhere on this page may change as those collections settle.
outcome.nobodyCharged: Nobody was charged. On IdeaNest a campaign that does not reach its goal collects nothing and pays no fee.

faqs.heading: Frequently asked questions
faqs.failed: The questions and answers could not be loaded just now. Reload the page to try again.
faqs.empty: This campaign has not answered any questions yet. Ask one in the comments and the creator can add the answer here.

updates.heading: Updates
updates.failed: The updates could not be loaded just now. Reload the page to try again.

comments.heading: Comments
comments.failed: The comments could not be loaded just now. Reload the page to try again.
comments.empty: Nobody has commented on this campaign yet.
comments.signedOut: Commenting needs an account. It is how the platform can tell one person from five copies of the same one, and how the creator can answer you.
comments.withdrawWarning: Withdrawing leaves a note saying the comment was removed. Any replies to it stay, and it cannot be edited or restored.
